_comment: Curated model gallery, editable without touching any Python. Structure: {backend: {llms: [...], embeddings: [...]}}. Each entry needs at least 'id' (the exact HuggingFace repo id or Ollama tag), 'name', 'publisher', 'params', and 'notes'. LLM entries also take 'context_window' and 'gated'. Embedding entries also take 'dims' and optionally 'query_instruction'/'text_instruction'. Set 'default': true on exactly one entry per list to flag it in the UI (the ACTUAL default is still controlled by LLM_MODEL_NAME/OLLAMA_LLM_MODEL etc. in .env — this flag is just a UI hint, keep them in sync).

llms.name: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2
llms.notes: Default generation model. Strong general-purpose quality, but noticeably heavier than the other options here — budget 16GB+ RAM for comfortable CPU inference, or use the Ollama backend's quantized Mistral for a much lighter footprint on the same model family.

llms.name: Phi-2
llms.notes: Lighter alternative to the default. Solid general-purpose reasoning for its size.

llms.name: Phi-4-mini
llms.notes: Newer architecture, strong instruction-following. Lighter than Mistral-7B, heavier than Phi-2.

llms.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
llms.notes: Fastest, lightest option here. Gated: requires an HF_TOKEN with the Meta license accepted.

llms.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
llms.notes: Good quality/speed balance. Gated: requires an HF_TOKEN with the Meta license accepted.

llms.name: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct
llms.notes: Compact, fast, MIT licensed. Good choice for CPU-only or memory-constrained deployments.

embeddings.name: MiniLM-L6-v2
embeddings.notes: Default embedding model. Fast, well-rounded baseline.

embeddings.name: BGE-small-en v1.5
embeddings.query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
embeddings.notes: Strong retrieval quality for its size. Instruction is auto-applied to queries.

embeddings.name: E5-small-v2
embeddings.notes: Needs query/passage prefixes for best results — applied automatically here.

embeddings.name: GTE-small
embeddings.notes: Good general-purpose compact embedding model, no special prefixes needed.

llms.name: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2 (Q4)
llms.notes: Default generation model. ~4.1GB quantized — the quantized route to the same model family as the HuggingFace default, at a fraction of the memory.

llms.name: Phi-3-mini (Q4)
llms.notes: Lighter alternative to the default. ~2.2GB quantized — good balance of quality and speed on CPU.

llms.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct (Q4)
llms.notes: Smallest, fastest option. ~0.7GB quantized. No gating via Ollama — license accepted by pulling the tag.

llms.name: Qwen 2.5 1.5B Instruct (Q4)
llms.notes: Strong for its size, especially structured/technical answers. ~1GB quantized.

embeddings.name: Nomic Embed Text
embeddings.notes: Default embedding model. Strong general-purpose retrieval quality.

embeddings.name: MxBai Embed Large
embeddings.notes: Higher quality, larger footprint (~670MB quantized) than the other options here.

embeddings.name: All-MiniLM (Ollama)
embeddings.notes: Smallest and fastest embedding option. Same family as the HuggingFace-backend default.
